{{Quote|The Rodian's name is Vralla. I'd be careful of her -- you foiled her partner, so she may be looking for you.|Zakarisz Ghent to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Vralla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThugRodianFemale.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Vralla]]
Vralla was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
